headline: From a full library to one teachable program
overview: The public library separates workouts, programs, and individual exercises, then opens a program without leaving the page. This walk uses the same controls a teacher uses to move from browsing to a concrete sequence.

steps.title: The class inventory at rest
steps.description: Programs, workouts, and exercises share one library, with counts visible before a teacher chooses a format.
steps.screenshotAlt: The Yoga Quest class library showing workouts and format counts

steps.title: Programs, not isolated workouts
steps.description: The grid changes to multi-session paths and shows duration and session counts, so the distinction is visible in the content rather than only in a label.
steps.screenshotAlt: Yoga Quest filtered to multi-session programs

steps.title: The program opens with its path
steps.description: The detail view names the program's sequence and progression in place, preserving the library context behind it.
steps.screenshotAlt: The Build a balance practice program detail
